feed.title: BlackRock uses Azure to strengthen Aladdin, its investment management platform
feed.summary: BlackRock is migrating its Aladdin investment platform to Microsoft Azure to enhance scalability, flexibility, and global reach for its clients. This strategic move allows BlackRock to deliver new products faster, meet client demands in more geographies, and innovate beyond the constraints of on-premises infrastructure. The migration is well underway, with about two-thirds of client instances already moved, demonstrating significant technological and business benefits.

feed.title: 3 things learned from Microsoft’s carbon removal report
feed.summary: Microsoft's latest carbon removal report reveals insights from its efforts to achieve net-zero by 2030. The company saw fewer, but higher quality, proposals for carbon removal projects after refining its RFP criteria. Microsoft is diversifying its high-durability solutions beyond direct air capture and continues to invest in biochar for medium-durability carbon storage.

feed.title: Quantum uncertainty: Is quantum computing really ready for action in business?
feed.summary: A survey indicates a growing interest in quantum computing among business executives, with many planning or already working with the technology. However, experts like Professor Sankar Das Sarma warn against the significant hype, suggesting that practical commercial applications are still a distant prospect and many current proposed use cases are not commercially viable yet. Analysts also note that while investment is flowing into quantum companies, true commercial applications remain scant, and broad adoption will likely come through hyperscale cloud providers in 5-10 years.

feed.title: Five Tech Trends That Will Shape PH Businesses in 2022
feed.summary: This article identifies five key tech trends that will influence Philippine businesses in 2022, as highlighted by SAP. These trends include accelerating digital transformation, prioritizing sustainability, integrating decision intelligence and hyperautomation, the rise of low-code/no-code technologies, and ensuring a total experience (TX) strategy. The article emphasizes the importance of these advancements for organizational survival and growth in the post-pandemic era, with a focus on how SAP (NYSE: SAP) can support businesses in adopting these technologies.

feed.title: Germany's tech giant SAP turns 50
feed.summary: SAP, Germany's prominent tech company, celebrates its 50th anniversary as the world's most-used business software provider. Starting with five former IBM employees in 1972, SAP now serves 99 of the 100 largest global companies and aims to spearhead digitalization efforts within Germany's public administration. The company has evolved from on-premise solutions to heavily investing in cloud technology, which generated €9.4 billion in 2021, with ambitious targets for future cloud revenue.

feed.title: Microsoft's cloud business targeted by EU antitrust regulators
feed.summary: EU antitrust regulators are questioning Microsoft's rivals and customers regarding its cloud business and licensing deals, potentially leading to a formal investigation. European antitrust enforcers are scrutinizing whether Microsoft is leveraging its dominant position in some software markets to unfairly compete in cloud computing services, following complaints from several European tech companies. The inquiry focuses on licensing deal terms, technical limitations, and the differences in license fees between various programs.

feed.title: Business On Air – MTR
feed.summary: This article features an interview with Ted Suen, CIO of MTR Corporation, discussing their digital transformation strategy and its impact on their 40,000 global staff. MTR, as Hong Kong's key railway operator, has a long history of technological innovation, and its current focus is on empowering employees and improving customer experience through its Digital Workplace Initiative. Suen emphasizes that executive support and an engaging change program, including gamification and design thinking, were crucial for overcoming challenges and seizing opportunities during the implementation, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic.

feed.title: Internet of Things Market Size [2022-2029] Worth USD 2465.26 Billion | Exhibiting a CAGR of 26.4%
feed.summary: The global Internet of Things (IoT) market is projected to reach USD 2,465.26 billion by 2029, growing at a CAGR of 26.4% from USD 384.70 billion in 2021. This growth is driven by the increasing penetration of smart cities, deployment of vehicle solutions, and strong demand from the healthcare sector. Key players like Amazon Web Services, Intel, and Microsoft are focusing on product rollouts and technological advancements.

feed.title: ProShares Opens New Headquarters, Affirms Commitment to Greater Washington D.C. Area
feed.summary: ProShares, a leading ETF provider, announced the opening of its new 54,000-sq.-ft. headquarters in downtown Bethesda, Maryland, reaffirming its commitment to the Greater Washington D.C. area. The move follows significant growth over the past three years, with assets under management more than doubling to over $70 billion and the launch of innovative products like the bitcoin-linked ETF (BITO). The new state-of-the-art office is designed for collaboration and positions the firm for future growth, with employees returning to in-office work.

feed.title: AMD to buy cloud startup Pensando for $1.9 billion in data center push
feed.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) announced its acquisition of cloud startup Pensando for $1.9 billion, excluding working capital adjustments, to strengthen its data center offerings. Pensando, founded by former Cisco engineers, provides a programmable processor and software platform used by clients like Goldman Sachs and Microsoft's Azure. This strategic move aims to boost AMD's competitiveness in the rapidly expanding data center chip market against rivals like Intel and Nvidia.

feed.title: AMD acquires data center chip startup Pensando for $1.9B
feed.summary: AMD announced its plan to acquire Pensando Systems Inc., a data center chip startup, for approximately $1.9 billion. Pensando develops chips that improve the efficiency of supporting tasks in data centers, such as managing storage infrastructure and coordinating network traffic, by performing these functions locally on accelerator cards attached to servers. This acquisition is expected to bolster AMD's fast-growing data center business, expanding its portfolio and enhancing its competitive position against rivals like Nvidia and Intel.

feed.title: AMD Buying John Chambers-Backed Pensando For $1.9B To Boost Cloud, Chip Innovation
feed.summary: AMD announced its acquisition of Pensando, an edge and cloud startup, for $1.9 billion to enhance its data center processors with Pensando's software stack and programmable packet processors. This strategic move aims to expand AMD's offerings for cloud, enterprise, and edge customers by leveraging Pensando's distributed services platform, which has been praised for its performance and efficiency. Pensando's CEO Prem Jain and his team will join AMD's Data Center Solutions Group, continuing to execute their product roadmap with increased scale and market reach.

feed.title: Elizabeth Hamren and Blake Jorgensen Join Hasbro’s Board of Directors
feed.summary: Hasbro, Inc. (NASDAQ: HAS) announced the appointment of Elizabeth Hamren, COO of Discord Inc., and Blake Jorgensen, EVP of Special Projects at Electronic Arts Inc., to its Board of Directors, effective April 1, 2022. These appointments are part of Hasbro's ongoing board refreshment and shareholder engagement initiatives. Both new directors bring extensive experience in technology, digital gaming, and financial acumen, which Hasbro believes will be vital for its continued growth and to unlock the value of its brands.

feed.title: Clean Harbors’ CIO: Hybrid approach to the cloud is a win-win
feed.summary: Clean Harbors, a hazardous waste cleanup giant, has adopted a hybrid cloud strategy, leveraging Microsoft Azure for advanced AI and RPA capabilities while retaining its core Waste Information Network (WIN) on-premises. This approach allows them to innovate with cloud services for customer-facing applications and data analytics, while ensuring the high availability and security of critical legacy systems and data, a model increasingly favored by enterprises. The company's CIO, Sharon Gabriel, highlights their cautious, methodical approach to cloud adoption, informed by past experiences and a need to manage 42 years of sensitive data.

feed.title: New York's Simpson Thacher names first new chair since 2013
feed.summary: Simpson Thacher & Bartlett has elected Alden Millard as its new chair, succeeding William Dougherty. Under Dougherty's leadership, the firm saw its revenue double to $2.2 billion and average equity partner profits reach $6 million. Millard, a corporate partner since 1996, will now lead the firm which thrived during the recent M&A boom.

feed.title: Investing in esports in the context of recent events
feed.summary: This article discusses the growth of esports, significant investment it has received, and current challenges due to global events like the COVID-19 pandemic and the Russia-Ukraine conflict. It identifies investment opportunities in publicly traded tech companies, specialized esports firms, and esports-focused ETFs, while also raising questions about future growth amidst potential new pandemics and the integration of NFTs.

feed.title: Oculus VisionTech Launches in AWS Marketplace
feed.summary: Oculus VisionTech Inc., through its subsidiary ComplyTrust Inc., has launched its Forget-Me-Yes® (FMY) data privacy solution in AWS Marketplace. This makes it easier for companies worldwide to achieve compliance with various data privacy regulations like CCPA, GDPR, and LGPD, particularly for right-of-deletion requests for Salesforce.org data. The cloud-native FMY platform offers a cost-effective, scalable, and secure way to manage data subject access requests through a monthly subscription.

feed.title: Startup Warp raises $23M to reinvent the venerable command-line terminal
feed.summary: Warp, a developer productivity startup, has successfully raised $23 million in funding, including a $6 million seed round and a $17 million Series A round. The company aims to modernize the command-line terminal, which it believes is an outdated tool despite being used daily by developers. Warp's new terminal is built with the Rust programming language, offers a modern interface, and includes features for improved collaboration and intelligent command suggestions, moving the terminal experience into the modern era for developers.

feed.title: Closing the Gaps with SAP Enable Now
feed.summary: This article discusses how SAP Enable Now helps businesses improve user adoption, productivity, and experience, especially in a remote work environment. Kristina Kunad, solution owner, highlights the importance of in-application help and training, the solution's integration with other SAP products, and its ability to provide ready-to-use content. She emphasizes SAP Enable Now's role in closing skill gaps and enabling organizations to effectively utilize SAP solutions across different departments.

feed.title: Putnam’s Collins Draws On Nature For ESG Investing Inspiration
feed.summary: Katherine Collins, head of sustainable investing at Putnam Investments, integrates biomimicry and insights from nature, specifically honeybees, into her ESG investment strategies. After a career in traditional finance and a master's degree from Harvard Divinity School, Collins applies a unique lens to identify companies demonstrating leadership in sustainability. Her approach focuses on balancing risk and opportunity, evidenced in her co-management of Putnam Sustainable Leaders (PNOYX) and Putnam Sustainable Future (PMVYX) funds.

feed.title: C3 AI's Ambition: World's Greatest Software
feed.summary: Tom Siebel, CEO of C3.ai (AI), discusses his renewed vision for enterprise AI, focusing on its predictive capabilities to deliver substantial economic value to customers. Despite C3.ai's stock performance challenges and questions about its core technology and business model, Siebel remains confident in the company's platform, strategic partnerships, financial strength, and long-term goal of becoming a leading software company by innovating how businesses operate through AI-driven foresight.

feed.title: Ball Aerospace Collaborates with Microsoft Azure on On-orbit Computing
feed.summary: Ball Aerospace is partnering with Microsoft Azure to enhance on-orbit satellite data processing, combining Ball's space-based hardware expertise with Microsoft's cloud capabilities. This collaboration aims to create "smart" satellites that extend cloud data processing power to space, enabling faster, more flexible, and dynamic data handling for complex missions. Future demonstrations will test this software on-orbit, leveraging Microsoft Azure's integrated cloud services for advanced analytics and mission-critical government workloads.

feed.title: Boeing and Microsoft deepen partnership in digital aviation
feed.summary: Boeing and Microsoft are expanding their strategic partnership, with Boeing leveraging the Microsoft Cloud and its AI capabilities to modernize its critical infrastructure, streamline business processes, and accelerate digital innovation in aviation. This collaboration aims to unlock sustainable value from Boeing's data, building on a long history of the companies working together in aerospace technology.

feed.title: Announcing The Forrester EDR Wave™: Advanced Features Are Left Behind In The Rush To XDR
feed.summary: This article announces the release of The Forrester Wave™: Endpoint Detection And Response Providers, Q2 2022, which evaluated 15 EDR vendors across 20 criteria. The report highlights that while EDR vendors are shifting focus towards XDR, security teams still require robust EDR offerings with advanced features for improved analyst workflows, resilience, and customization. It recommends choosing EDR vendors that provide meaningful contextualization, customizable automation, and a clear product vision.

feed.title: Take-Two Interactive Software Inc. stock outperforms competitors despite losses on the day
feed.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software Inc. stock fell 3.09% on Wednesday amidst a broader market decline, closing at $147.20. Despite the loss, the stock demonstrated mixed performance compared to competitors like Microsoft, Sony, and Activision Blizzard, which also experienced declines. The trading volume for Take-Two exceeded its 50-day average.

feed.title: Leveraging Intel Technology as a Force for Good
feed.summary: Intel's RISE Technology Initiative supported 63 projects in the past year, investing $9.5 million to leverage Intel technology, employee talent, and partnerships for global good. These projects address accessibility, economic recovery, education, health and life sciences, social equity and human rights, and sustainability and climate. The initiative demonstrates how technology can be a force for positive change across diverse communities worldwide.

feed.title: House Republicans want to axe Citi contracts over bank's abortion benefits
feed.summary: House Republicans are calling for the cancellation of government contracts with Citigroup after the banking giant announced it would cover travel costs for employees seeking abortions. Republican Rep. Mike Johnson and 44 other lawmakers argue that continuing the contract would violate the policy of not funding abortions with taxpayer money. This controversy highlights the increasing focus on companies' stances on political and social issues, with other corporations also facing scrutiny for their policies on reproductive healthcare and other contentious matters.

feed.title: What’s Changed: 2022 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Transportation Management Systems
feed.summary: This article highlights the changes in the 2022 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Transportation Management Systems (TMS), outlining the core and expanded capabilities of TMS software. It details the leaders, challengers, and niche players identified by Gartner, providing insights into their strengths, weaknesses, and target markets. Key updates include the addition of 3Gtms and the absence of BluJay Solutions due to its acquisition by E2open.

feed.title: Shuffle Board: C-Suite Moves at Nordstrom, Burlington, JD, Zappos, American Textile
feed.summary: This article details significant C-suite personnel changes across several major retail and textile companies, including Nordstrom, Burlington Stores, JD.com, Zappos.com, and American Textile Company. Key appointments and retirements are highlighted, along with new roles aimed at strategic growth, customer experience, and sustainability within these organizations. The changes reflect ongoing efforts by these companies to adapt to market demands and streamline operations.

feed.title: Oracle Named a 2022 Gartner® Peer Insights™ ‘Voice of the Customer’: Enterprise Low-Code Application Platforms
feed.summary: Oracle has been recognized as a Customers’ Choice in the 2022 Gartner® Peer Insights™ ‘Voice of the Customer’: Enterprise Low-Code Application Platforms for Oracle APEX, based on customer reviews. Oracle APEX is a low-code development platform, offered as a no-cost feature of Oracle Database and available for free on Oracle Cloud's Always Free services, empowering developers to build scalable enterprise apps. The article includes testimonials from customers praising APEX for its speed, functionality, and ability to solve business problems.

feed.title: Meta (FB) Plans to Introduce Virtual Coins to Diversify Income
feed.summary: Meta Platforms (FB) is exploring the introduction of virtual coins, tokens, and lending services within its applications to reduce its reliance on advertising revenue. The company plans to create in-app tokens, similar to those in games like Roblox, and also social tokens and "creator coins" for influencers, rather than a blockchain-based cryptocurrency like its failed Diem project. This strategic shift aims to diversify its income streams and engage users amidst increasing competition and regulatory scrutiny.

feed.title: DeFiChain Adds New dTokens Corresponding to Disney, Intel, MicroStrategy, and iShares MSCI China ETF
feed.summary: DeFiChain has announced the addition of four new decentralized tokens, or dTokens, following a community vote. These new dTokens correspond to Walt Disney Co ($dDIS), iShares MSCI China ETF ($dMCHI), MicroStrategy Incorporated ($dMSTR), and Intel Corporation ($dINTC), allowing users to gain price exposure to these traditional assets without ownership. DeFiChain, a blockchain built on the Bitcoin network, aims to provide decentralized financial applications and services, expanding its dToken universe to offer an alternative to traditional financial brokers.

feed.title: Native Advertising Vs Social Media: What Do Audiences Prefer? Outbrain-Savanta Report
feed.summary: A report by Outbrain and Savanta indicates a shift in consumer behavior, with global audiences planning to spend less time on social media and showing a greater preference for editorial content environments. The study reveals that consumers trust editorial sites and the ads within them more than social media, and consider native advertising less intrusive. Marketers are advised to diversify their strategies to include advertising on open-web publishers to align with these changing preferences.

feed.title: Data Analytics Market Size to grow by USD 196.47 Billion | 32% of the market growth will originate from APAC | 17,000+ Technavio Reports
feed.summary: The global data analytics market is projected to grow by USD 196.47 billion from 2021 to 2026, accelerating at a CAGR of 13.54%. The services component segment dominated the market in 2021 and will continue to do so. APAC is expected to contribute 32% of the market's growth, with China and India being key markets.

feed.title: Nikon Partners with Microsoft to Produce VR and 3D Video Content
feed.summary: Nikon has established a new wholly-owned subsidiary, Nikon Creates Corporation, which will focus on planning, shooting, and producing volumetric, VR, and 3D content. This new venture makes Nikon the first licensed partner of Microsoft’s Mixed Reality Capture Studios, leveraging high-end production technology. Nikon Creates plans to open a state-of-the-art video production facility in Tokyo in Fall 2022, offering clients advanced video solutions for entertainment and advertising.

feed.title: Metaverse Market Size [2022-2029] Worth USD 1527.55 Billion | Exhibiting a CAGR of 47.6%
feed.summary: The metaverse market is projected to grow significantly from USD 100.27 billion in 2022 to USD 1,527.55 billion by 2029, showcasing a CAGR of 47.6%. This growth is primarily driven by the increasing penetration of online shopping and gaming, alongside advancements in blockchain technology and VR devices. Key companies leading this expansion include Tencent Holdings Ltd., NVIDIA Corporation, Meta, and Microsoft Corporation, who are focusing on product portfolio expansion and technological innovation.

feed.title: Identity Security Company SailPoint Acquired By Thoma Bravo -
feed.summary: Thoma Bravo is set to acquire identity security company SailPoint Technologies for $6.9 billion, a deal that includes a "go-shop" period until May 16, 2022, allowing SailPoint to seek alternative bids. This acquisition highlights Thoma Bravo's growing presence in the cybersecurity market, adding another company to its portfolio which already includes Barracuda Networks, Proofpoint, and Sophos. SailPoint, which reported significant revenue growth in Q4 2021, brings its M&A experience and MSP partnerships to the private equity firm, further strengthening its market position.

feed.title: Amazon unexpectedly renews employee monitoring debate
feed.summary: Amazon's consideration of an employee monitoring tool that would block certain words and phrases like "injustice," "ethics," "living wage," and "robots" on an internal messaging app has sparked renewed debate about employee monitoring. While Amazon states its intention is to screen offensive or harassing language, critics like Paul Starkman and Andrew Konya argue that such tools risk stifling employee voices and can lead to discontent, higher turnover, and a company missing crucial truths. The article suggests that alternative HR tools exist for gathering authentic employee feedback without resorting to surveillance that could harm company culture and reputation.

feed.title: These Black Women Launched An AI-Powered Beauty Tech And Secured Backing From Serena Ventures
feed.summary: Parfait, an AI and facial recognition-powered beauty technology, has successfully closed a $5 million Seed funding round led by Upfront Ventures and Serena Ventures. Founded by four Black women with extensive tech backgrounds, Parfait aims to revolutionize the wig market by applying AI to solve problems like AI biases and the fragmented wig buying process for women of color. The funds will be used to enhance production and automate supply chain capabilities to provide personalized experiences for customers in the rapidly growing wig industry.

feed.title: Arista Networks Inc. stock falls Monday, underperforms market
feed.summary: Arista Networks Inc. (ANET) stock dropped 2.95% on Monday, closing at $127.16, underperforming the broader market. The S&P 500 Index and Dow Jones Industrial Average also saw declines on the same day. This marked the second consecutive day of losses for Arista Networks, bringing its stock $21.41 below its 52-week high.

feed.title: Sony And LEGO's Parent Company Are Investing Billions Of Dollars in Epic Games
feed.summary: Sony is investing an additional $1 billion in Epic Games, with KIRKBI (LEGO's parent company) also contributing $1 billion, to deepen their combined investment in the metaverse. This funding builds on previous investments and aims to accelerate the development of interconnected digital spaces where creators and users can interact. Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney emphasizes the goal of fostering fun, immersive brand experiences, and community building within the metaverse.

feed.title: ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott: ‘We’re In A Market Of One’
feed.summary: ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott asserts his company is the workflow automation market leader, aiming to become a $15 billion SaaS powerhouse by building a "platform of platforms." He contends ServiceNow operates in a "market of one" due to its unique ability to integrate and automate disparate enterprise workflows onto a single, cloud-native platform, addressing what he calls "islands of automation" that hinder business flexibility and security. McDermott also emphasizes the critical role of channel partners and talent development in ServiceNow's vision for growth and innovation, including significant R&D investment and a focus on AI and low-code platforms.

feed.title: Vnet receives acquisition offer from Chinese investment firms
feed.summary: Vnet, formerly 21Vianet, has received an unsolicited preliminary non-binding acquisition offer from Chinese investment firms Hina Group and Industrial Bank Co., Ltd. The proposal is to acquire all outstanding ordinary shares for US$8 in cash per American depositary share. Following the announcement, Vnet's shares jumped over 20 percent, despite having fallen significantly earlier in the year.

feed.title: Visa Inc. Appoints Teri List to its Board of Directors
feed.summary: Visa Inc. has announced the appointment of Teri List to its board of directors, effective April 11, 2022. Ms. List brings extensive financial and leadership experience from previous executive roles at companies such as Gap Inc., DICK’S Sporting Goods Inc., Kraft Foods Group, Inc., and The Procter and Gamble Company. Her appointment increases Visa's board to 11 members, and she is expected to provide valuable insights on risk management, strategic planning, and financial oversight.

feed.title: Visa Appoints Teri List To Its Board
feed.summary: Visa has announced the appointment of Teri List to its board of directors, effective April 11, 2022. Ms. List brings extensive financial and leadership experience from previous executive roles at Gap Inc., DICK'S Sporting Goods Inc., Kraft Foods Group, Inc., and The Procter and Gamble Company. Her expertise in risk management, strategic planning, and financial oversight is expected to provide diverse perspectives to Visa's board.

feed.title: 13 must-have accessories for your new Peloton Guide
feed.summary: This article lists 13 essential accessories for new Peloton Guide users, including dumbbells, workout mats, heart rate monitors, fans, recovery tools, and supplements. It provides specific product recommendations and explanations for how each item can enhance the Peloton Guide workout experience. The goal is to help users maximize results from their strength training with the Peloton Guide.

feed.title: Vista Equity Invests In Critical Start; MDR Security Attracts More Venture Capital Funding
feed.summary: Vista Equity Partners has invested approximately $215 million in Critical Start, an MDR cybersecurity services provider, highlighting strong venture capital interest in the managed detection and response (MDR) market. Critical Start, which aims for 35% growth by the end of 2022, boasts an MDR platform that resolves over 99% of security alerts and has seen annual recurring revenue grow by over 400% in the last three years. This investment follows similar funding successes for other MDR companies, underscoring the increasing demand for 24/7 cyber threat vigilance.

feed.title: Thoma Bravo to buy cybersecurity firm SailPoint in a $6.9 bln deal
feed.summary: Private equity firm Thoma Bravo announced its acquisition of cybersecurity firm SailPoint Technologies for $6.9 billion. SailPoint shareholders will receive $65.25 per share, representing a 31.5% premium. This deal reflects the increased demand for security software due to remote work and global conflicts, and continues Thoma Bravo's trend of significant investments in the tech sector.

feed.title: Sungard Availability Services Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
feed.summary: Sungard Availability Services has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the U.S. and for protection under the CCAA in Canada, seeking to complete the process within four to six months. This follows a previous Chapter 11 filing in 2019 and insolvency proceedings for its UK subsidiary, highlighting ongoing financial distress due to declining revenue, fixed costs, and competition from cloud providers. The company's restructuring support agreement contemplates either a sale of assets or equitization of its prepetition funded debt.

feed.title: BPCL collaborates with Microsoft to leverage cloud and AI to redefine customer experience
feed.summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd. (BPCL) and Microsoft have announced a seven-year strategic cloud partnership to accelerate BPCL's digital transformation and enhance customer experience in the oil and gas industry. This collaboration, part of BPCL's 'Project Anubhav', will leverage Microsoft's cloud and AI capabilities, including Azure, for initiatives like UFill for an innovative fueling solution, IoT-powered supply chains, and a conversational AI chatbot named Urja for customer support. The partnership aims to build a resilient, cloud-led business operation, redefine customer experience through trust, personalization, and convenience, and strengthen BPCL's business operations with security at its core.

feed.title: 5 Tech Stocks to Buy Now According to Robert Pitts’ Steadfast Capital
feed.summary: This article identifies five tech stocks that Robert Pitts' Steadfast Capital was bullish on as of the fourth quarter of 2021. It highlights Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. (FIS) as one of these stocks, detailing Steadfast Capital's stake and the number of hedge funds holding it. The article also includes commentary from Baron Funds regarding FIS's performance and future outlook, despite concerns about its legacy technology.

feed.title: John Deere's supply chief Wiggins on why flexibility is key
feed.summary: Wallas Wiggins, VP Global Supply Management & Logistics at John Deere, discusses the critical role of flexibility and strong supplier relationships in navigating challenges like the pandemic. He emphasizes the importance of employee engagement, resilience, and adapting processes to achieve desired outcomes efficiently. Wiggins highlights that the pandemic taught him valuable lessons about supporting staff and preparing for the future through diversification and risk mitigation.

feed.title: UK gamers prepare for ‘post-console’ future, finds Amdocs
feed.summary: Amdocs research indicates that UK gamers are increasingly ready for a "post-console" future, driven by cloud gaming and 5G connectivity. The study found high enthusiasm for cloud gaming and the metaverse, with many gamers willing to pay more for these services and forgo new hardware purchases. Key priorities for gamers include content quality and the ability to stream from any device, while concerns about the metaverse mainly revolve around its early stage, hardware costs, and internet connection capabilities.

feed.title: AI used for chip counting at City of Dreams Manila
feed.summary: City of Dreams Manila is now using AI technology developed by Cogniac Corp to count and verify casino chips with 99.7% accuracy, significantly increasing speed and efficiency. This implementation for a loyalty program is noted as a unique AI application in the casino industry, allowing Melco Resorts to reallocate staff to more strategic areas and enhance operational accuracy and guest experience.

feed.title: How technology is transforming the future of performance marketing
feed.summary: Technology is becoming increasingly vital in performance marketing, offering benefits like omnichannel mapping, real-time data, mobile-first strategies, powerful AI-driven ad stacks, and robust fraud protection tools. These advancements help brands connect with audiences more effectively, optimize ad spend, and maintain ROI in an evolving digital landscape. The article highlights how ad-tech ensures campaigns are impactful and efficient.

feed.title: Microsoft India appoints Amrita Thapar as its CMO
feed.summary: Microsoft India has appointed Amrita Thapar as its new Chief Marketing Officer. Thapar previously served as India communications lead at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and held a vice president role at Genpact for over 13 years. She brings more than 15 years of experience in marketing and communications to her new role, specializing in brand storytelling, digital operations, and corporate communications.

feed.title: Wide-Moat Funds Play Defense Well
feed.summary: The article discusses how funds investing in wide-moat companies, characterized by sustainable competitive advantages, tend to perform defensively during economic downturns. These funds, often focused on quality or dividend growth, show consistency in holding wide-moat stocks and exhibit better risk-adjusted returns and downside protection compared to funds with low-moat holdings. While wide-moat stocks can trade at a premium and may not always outperform in bull markets, their defensive characteristics make them appealing for long-term stability.

feed.title: BPCL teams up with Microsoft to leverage cloud, AI technologies
feed.summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) has formed a strategic cloud partnership with Microsoft to accelerate its digital transformation and foster innovation within the oil and gas industry. This collaboration, spanning seven years, will leverage Microsoft's secure cloud platform, including Azure native services for IoT and analytics, to enhance BPCL's operations, supply chains, and customer engagement. The initiative aligns with BPCL's "Project Anubhav" aimed at redefining customer experience through trust, personalization, and convenience.

feed.title: Why the Immense Selling Pressure on the SPY ETF Must End
feed.summary: The article discusses why the intense selling pressure on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is likely to subside, presenting a buying opportunity. It attributes recent declines to concerns surrounding major holdings like Microsoft, Amazon, and Tesla, including antitrust reviews, Rivian losses, and Elon Musk's distraction with Twitter. Despite these issues, the author argues that the fundamental strength of the top companies in the S&P 500 remains, and investors should accumulate SPY shares on dips.

feed.title: What is Adobe Experience Cloud? CRM platform overview
feed.summary: Adobe Experience Cloud is a comprehensive CRM platform designed for medium to large enterprises, offering tools to manage sales, marketing, and customer support. It facilitates the customer journey through data-driven insights with integrated features like targeted list generators, email campaigns, and real-time data updates. The platform also integrates with various third-party systems and social media, providing a unified view of customer interactions and supporting personalized digital experiences.

feed.title: Announcing Analyst Experience: SOC Analysts Finally Escape The Shackles Of Bad UX
feed.summary: Forrester introduces "Analyst Experience" (AX), a new framework addressing the inadequate tools and processes faced by Security Operations Center (SOC) analysts. AX aims to improve security analysts' interactions with security products, services, and processes, building on concepts like user experience (UX) and customer experience (CX). The framework outlines five elements—discover, explore, classify, determine, and execute—to enhance the SOC workflow and will be a key focus in upcoming security technologies.

feed.title: Worker expectations push employers to address pay compression, survey finds
feed.summary: A Robert Half survey reveals that market conditions and employee expectations are compelling employers to address pay compression, with 56% observing discrepancies between new hires and tenured staff. In response, 62% of executives are regularly reviewing compensation plans and increasing salaries for existing employees. This proactive approach is driven by the fact that many employees plan to ask for raises due to living costs, and a significant portion would seek new employment if denied.

feed.title: Putting zero trust into practice: An overview of Zscaler’s platform offerings, solution elements, and partner ecosystem
feed.summary: This article provides a comprehensive overview of Zscaler's Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) platform, detailing its components designed to secure users, workloads, and IoT/OT systems. It explains how integrated solutions like Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) enable secure connectivity and data protection. The piece also highlights Zscaler's ecosystem integrations that consolidate vendor services and optimize cloud access.

feed.title: Microsoft Launches Operator Connect Accelerator
feed.summary: Microsoft has introduced the Operator Connect Accelerator program to help carriers achieve Operator Connect accreditation more quickly. This initiative involves certified partners assisting service providers with API integration, managed SBC as a service, and other necessary steps to streamline the process. The program aims to reduce time-to-market for telecom services integrating with Microsoft Teams, making it easier for businesses to adopt Teams as their primary phone system.

feed.title: LinkedIn was the most exploited brand in phishing attacks last quarter
feed.summary: LinkedIn became the most exploited brand in phishing attacks during Q1 2022, accounting for 52% of all analyzed attempts, a significant jump from 8% in the previous quarter. Cyber threat intelligence provider Check Point Research reported this surge, noting that phishers are increasingly leveraging social networks. The article details examples of these attacks, including spoofed LinkedIn and Maersk emails, and offers tips to avoid falling victim to phishing.

feed.title: Digital Transformation That Sticks: Creating a Capabilities Ecosystem for Effective Learning
feed.summary: This article argues that successful digital transformation requires creating a capabilities ecosystem rather than relying on traditional training models. It contrasts two hypothetical companies: one that fails due to an inadequate "learn as you go" approach, and another that succeeds by implementing a holistic capabilities ecosystem. This ecosystem integrates organizational change management, instructional design, and other disciplines to align learning with business strategy, foster continuous support, and build organizational resilience.

feed.title: The rise of mini data centers
feed.summary: The article discusses the growing trend of mini data centers, which are becoming crucial for edge computing as data demands increase. These compact, cost-effective facilities reduce latency by bringing computing power closer to users, making them ideal for densely populated areas and various applications in retail, banking, and offices. The global market for mini data centers is projected to reach $8.6 billion by 2027, with significant investments in regions like Asia-Pacific, particularly India.

feed.title: FIS’ Modern Banking Platform Now Available on the Microsoft Azure Cloud Platform
feed.summary: FIS announced that its Modern Banking Platform is now available on the Microsoft Azure cloud, expanding digital online banking services to financial institutions in the UK, Thailand, and New Zealand. This platform integrates advanced cloud security, monitoring, resiliency, and operational analytics with a cloud-native core, utilizing AI and component-based architecture. This partnership enables banks to quickly develop and deliver new products and services, adapting to regulatory changes and escalating customer expectations.

feed.title: IBM Revenue Up 8% on Continued Momentum in Hybrid Cloud Business
feed.summary: International Business Machines Corp. reported an 8% revenue increase in the first quarter, surpassing analysts' expectations, driven primarily by strong performance in its hybrid cloud platform. Revenue rose to $14.2 billion from $13.19 billion a year earlier, beating the anticipated $13.78 billion. This growth reflects the continued momentum in IBM's hybrid cloud business, which saw a 14% revenue increase, highlighting its importance in the company's transformation strategy.

feed.title: Netflix Loses $54 Billion in Market Cap After Biggest One-Day Stock Drop Ever
feed.summary: Netflix experienced its biggest one-day stock drop ever, losing $54 billion in market capitalization after announcing its first subscriber loss in over a decade and projecting further losses. Analysts downgraded the stock, citing market saturation, increased competition, and the impact of account sharing, leading to a significant reassessment of the company's growth prospects.

feed.title: Latest Oracle Exadata servers ascend to the cloud
feed.summary: Oracle has announced the availability of its latest Exadata Cloud Infrastructure X9M appliance in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, marking the rollout of its newest generation of Exadata processors. This new service, based on AMD microprocessors, offers significant improvements in performance, throughput, and capacity without increased costs, allowing organizations to consolidate various database workloads. Oracle claims superior performance compared to AWS RDS and Azure SQL, with the service designed for scalable deployment both on-premises and across Oracle's expanding global cloud footprint.

feed.title: JPMorgan Chase, Microsoft among growing number of companies turning to neurodiverse workers to help meet need for talent
feed.summary: A growing number of companies, including JPMorgan Chase and Microsoft, are actively recruiting neurodiverse individuals to fill talent needs and leverage their unique skills. This trend is driven by an increasing recognition of the neurodiverse population, their problem-solving abilities, and the ongoing demand for talent, with companies implementing structured programs for interviewing, hiring, and onboarding. These initiatives not only provide career opportunities for neurodiverse workers but also positively impact company culture and team dynamics.

feed.title: Arista Networks Inc. stock falls Wednesday, underperforms market
feed.summary: Arista Networks Inc. (ANET) stock fell 1.30% on Wednesday to $127.16, underperforming the broader market. The stock closed $21.41 below its 52-week high and also trailed competitors like Microsoft, Cisco Systems, and HP Inc., which all saw gains. Trading volume for Arista Networks exceeded its 50-day average.

feed.title: Apple Spends Record High on Lobbying Amid Pressure from Congress
feed.summary: Apple Inc. spent a record $2.5 million on lobbying in the first quarter of 2022, marking a 34% increase from the previous quarter. This significant expenditure comes as the company faces growing pressure from the U.S. Congress regarding antitrust concerns. Other major tech companies like Alphabet, Meta, and Microsoft are also heavily investing in lobbying efforts as Congress considers antitrust legislation that could impact the technology sector.

feed.title: International Business Machines Corp. stock outperforms market on strong trading day
feed.summary: International Business Machines Corp. (IBM) shares rose 1.11% to $139.85, outperforming a generally down market where the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average both fell. This marks the third consecutive day of gains for IBM, which also outperformed competitors like Apple, Microsoft, and Alphabet. The company closed $6.14 below its 52-week high, and its trading volume was more than double its 50-day average.

feed.title: Lapsus$ Cyberattack Victim List: Globant, Microsoft, Nvidia, Okta, Samsung, T-Mobile -
feed.summary: The Lapsus$ hacker group continued to target high-profile companies even after some alleged members were arrested in March 2022. This article lists several major companies, including Globant, Microsoft, Nvidia, Okta, Samsung, and T-Mobile, that have been victims of Lapsus$ cyberattacks. It also provides guidance on how to protect against and respond to ransomware attacks, emphasizing data backups, multi-factor authentication, and prompt incident reporting.

feed.title: ST looks to integrate AzureRTOS with microcontroller IP
feed.summary: STMicroelectronics has expanded its support for Microsoft's Azure RTOS within the STM32Cube development environment, now covering an extensive range of STM32 microcontrollers. This integration allows Azure RTOS to leverage key intellectual property in STM32 MCUs, including hardware crypto cores, and provides developers with free, certified, and user-friendly tools. The move aims to lower the barrier to entry for embedded systems development with Azure RTOS, offering comprehensive middleware, application examples, and support for various STM32 boards.

feed.title: Northwell Health Collaborates with Teladoc Health to Improve System Wide Virtual Care
feed.summary: Northwell Health, New York's largest healthcare provider, has partnered with Teladoc Health to expand its virtual care services. This collaboration will leverage Teladoc Health's platform and its integration with Microsoft Teams to enhance clinical teamwork, communication, and patient access to a broad spectrum of clinical services through a unified consumer experience. The implementation begins with 20 Northwell Health hospitals, aiming to optimize direct-to-consumer telehealth programs for improved access and quality of care.

feed.title: Leaked Chats Show LAPSUS$ Stole T-Mobile Source Code – Krebs on Security
feed.summary: Leaked private chat messages from the LAPSUS$ cybercrime group reveal they breached T-Mobile multiple times in March 2022, stealing source code for various projects. Despite T-Mobile's claim that no customer or government information was compromised, the chats detail LAPSUS$'s methods, including purchasing access, social engineering employees, and utilizing internal tools like Atlas to look up sensitive accounts. The article also highlights the group's internal conflicts, their leader's fixation on stealing source code, and their eventual undoing due to compromised servers and arrests.

feed.title: Cloud Architect: The Tech Skill Everyone Wants to Learn?
feed.summary: Cloud architecture is rapidly becoming the most sought-after tech skill, with a 285% jump in class participation on Udemy. This demand is driven by the widespread adoption of cloud infrastructure by organizations, leading to a significant skills shortage. Cloud architects command a median annual salary of $131,513 and require expertise in AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and continuous learning of diverse technical and soft skills.

feed.title: Kraft Heinz and Microsoft join forces to accelerate supply chain transformation
feed.summary: Kraft Heinz is partnering with Microsoft to digitally transform its supply chain using Microsoft Azure, marking its largest technology investment to date. This collaboration aims to create a more resilient supply chain by establishing a "supply chain control tower" and "digital twins" of manufacturing facilities, leveraging AI, IoT, and data analytics. The initiative seeks to enhance operational efficiency, anticipate consumer demand, and optimize product delivery for Kraft Heinz's extensive portfolio.

feed.title: Solve Customer Mysteries With Quantitative And Qualitative Investigation
feed.summary: This article emphasizes the importance of combining quantitative and qualitative approaches to achieve true customer understanding. It highlights how a siloed approach often fails to provide a holistic view of customers and suggests that customer experience practitioners should lead the integration of both types of analysis. The author will be speaking at Forrester’s CX APAC event to present best practices for using combined methods to solve customer mysteries, using examples like churn analysis.

feed.title: What is fintech and why does it matter?
feed.summary: Fintech, a combination of “financial” and “technology,” refers to software that makes financial processes more accessible and automates traditional financial services. Kirsty Rutter, Fintech Investment Director at Lloyds Banking Group, explains how fintech is transforming banking by improving customer experiences through technologies like AI and machine learning. Lloyds Banking Group is actively investing in and collaborating with fintech companies to enhance its services and maintain a competitive edge.

feed.title: Tim Aimone – Hewlett Packard Enterprise
feed.summary: Tim Aimone, Director of Workplace Design and Project Management at Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), led the design of the company's new Houston headquarters. Opened in February 2022, the innovative office space is a "workplace of the future" designed for a hybrid work model, emphasizing collaboration, comfort, and integration of technology. The design prioritizes flexibility and employee well-being, reflecting lessons learned from the pandemic and HPE's existing "work from the edge" philosophy.

feed.title: How LV Vaidyanathan, the Satya Nadella fan, is looking to rewrite P&G India's fortunes
feed.summary: LV Vaidyanathan, a P&G veteran and IIM-Ahmedabad alumnus, is set to take over as P&G India's head from July 1, 2022. He aims to transform the company's operations in India to capitalize on the country's strong growth prospects in the FMCG market. Inspired by Satya Nadella, Vaidyanathan plans to change the company's culture and image, focusing on product superiority, innovation, and sustainability.

feed.title: Low Volatility Stocks Usually Do Well—But There Are Traps
feed.summary: A Northern Trust Asset Management paper warns that while low-volatility stocks generally outperform over time, they can present traps, particularly in real estate, utilities, and consumer staples sectors. Rising interest rates and economic vulnerability can negatively impact these types of low-volatility holdings. NTAM advises focusing on companies with strong cash flows, profitability, and solid balance sheets to mitigate these risks.

feed.title: Funds That Buy Like Buffett, 2022
feed.summary: This article identifies mutual funds that invest similarly to Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway. It highlights funds that hold a high percentage of the same stocks as Buffett's portfolio, with a particular focus on Apple. The piece also discusses the investment strategies of these funds and their performance.

feed.title: Crescent Hotels & Resorts Adds Aloft Mountain View to Latitudes Collection
feed.summary: Crescent Hotels & Resorts has expanded its Latitudes Collection with the addition of the Aloft Mountain View. This property, formerly a Hilton Garden Inn, underwent extensive renovations and is designed to attract energetic business travelers with its vibrant, tech-savvy atmosphere and modern amenities. Located near major tech companies in Silicon Valley, the hotel offers a 24/7 fitness center, an outdoor heated pool, event space, and on-site dining options.

feed.title: Microsoft (MSFT) Q3 revenue up 18%, earnings beat estimates
feed.summary: Microsoft Corp. reported strong third-quarter 2022 results, with revenues increasing by 18% to $49.4 billion, surpassing analyst expectations. The company's net income also rose to $16.7 billion, or $2.22 per share, exceeding estimates. This performance was significantly driven by a 29% growth in server products and cloud services revenue, particularly Azure.

feed.title: Kraft Heinz taps Microsoft to build up supply chain visibility
feed.summary: Kraft Heinz is partnering with Microsoft to enhance its supply chain visibility and resilience. The collaboration involves creating a "Supply Chain Control Tower" and "digital twins" of 34 manufacturing facilities using Microsoft's Azure, machine learning, and analytics to improve efficiency and address disruptions. This move is part of Kraft Heinz's broader digital transformation strategy.

feed.title: Android Can Now Sync with Windows PCs via Phone Link App, Like Apple Devices
feed.summary: Android phones can now sync with Windows PCs through Microsoft's Phone Link app, enabling users to access notifications, messages, and calls directly from their computer, similar to how Apple devices operate. This integration, especially with Windows 11, allows for seamless management of smartphone features and even enables running Android native applications on the PC. The setup involves simple QR code scanning and ensures updated operating systems and apps for both devices.

feed.title: Equinix Q1 2022: xScale Quarterly Leasing Activity Drops to Zero
feed.summary: Equinix reported its Q1 2022 earnings, showing a 10% year-over-year revenue increase but also a significant halt in leasing activity for its hyperscale xScale facilities. The company provided financial guidance for 2022, continued its global data center expansion, and outlined recent acquisitions and joint ventures, while noting that no new xScale capacity was leased in the quarter.

feed.title: Kraft-Heinz Credits Growth To Core, Conventional Lines and Company’s ‘Consumer Obsession’
feed.summary: Kraft Heinz reported a 6.8% increase in Q1 2022 organic net sales, attributing its success to the affordability of core brands, strategic hedging against inflation, and responsive retail demand. The company also saw significant growth in its foodservice arm and international expansion, while leveraging data-driven insights and AI for product innovation and marketing.

feed.title: Slack is definitely part of Salesforce now, and here’s proof
feed.summary: Salesforce and Slack are launching "Salesforce Platform for Slack," allowing developers to build functionality that integrates Salesforce data into Slack. This move solidifies Slack's integration with its parent company, offering enhanced collaboration and automation capabilities while still maintaining compatibility with third-party business tools. Slack cofounder Cal Henderson provides a nuanced perspective on the acquisition, highlighting the benefits of working with Salesforce's thriving ecosystem.

feed.title: Why AWS, Microsoft, Google, Visa Are Setting Base In Kenya
feed.summary: Major tech companies like Amazon Web Services, Microsoft, Google, and Visa are establishing operations in Kenya due to its growing economy and increasing client demand for cloud computing services. Kenya's strategic location as East Africa's largest economy and a hub for Fortune 500 companies makes it an attractive market for expansion. This move is driven by the need to meet local data residency requirements and capitalize on the burgeoning African cloud computing industry.

feed.title: Oracle teams with Verizon as it expands global network of industry innovation labs
feed.summary: Oracle has opened a new 30,000 sq ft Industry Lab near Chicago, in partnership with Verizon, to allow customers and partners to develop and test solutions using Oracle's technology across various industries. This lab will initially focus on energy and water, construction and engineering, communications, and manufacturing, with additional labs planned for England and Australia. The initiative aims to address complex industry challenges through collaborative innovation in simulated real-world environments.

feed.title: HCL Technologies brings All Access Media Marketplace Platform
feed.summary: HCL Technologies has launched its All Access Media Marketplace Platform at NAB Las Vegas, aiming to streamline content creation and distribution processes. Developed in coordination with Microsoft and CoreSite, the platform addresses workflow, application, and vendor discovery challenges for media creators. It features HCL Workflow Creator for building workflows, leverages Microsoft 365 for communication, and utilizes Azure Cloud for cybersecurity, aligning with MovieLabs 2030 Vision.

feed.title: Ansys simulation software to be used in CU Boulder graduate program
feed.summary: Ansys Inc., an engineering simulation software company based in Pittsburgh, is partnering with the University of Colorado Boulder. Their software will be integrated into the university's new Professional Master’s Program in High-Speed Digital Engineering. This collaboration aims to provide students with advanced simulation tools relevant to their field.

feed.title: Electronic Arts seeks more influencers as it opens Creator Network to all
feed.summary: Electronic Arts is expanding its Creator Network, previously an invite-only initiative, to all influencers globally. This program aims to build direct connections with various content creators, offering them early access to games, mentorship, and resources. EA plans to grow the network to 5,000 active members by the end of 2022 to enhance content creation around its brands.

feed.title: Advisors Are Powering Portfolios With Thematic ETFs
feed.summary: Thematic ETFs, which invest in companies poised to benefit from long-term transformative changes, are increasingly being adopted by financial advisors as a replacement for traditional sector funds. These ETFs offer more precise exposure to growth trends like blockchain, emergent food, robotics, and electric vehicles. Asset managers are expanding their thematic ETF offerings, with BlackRock (iShares) recently launching two new products in this space, highlighting a growing conviction in the long-term benefits of thematic investing despite some recent market volatility.

feed.title: The Cybersecurity Threats Self-Storage Operators Face Today and How to Defend Against Attacks
feed.summary: This article discusses the increasing cybersecurity threats faced by self-storage operators, who are often targeted due to fewer resources compared to larger companies. It outlines common attack types such as ransomware, spearfishing, cryptomining malware, cloud vulnerabilities, and endpoint attacks. The piece also provides actionable defense strategies including staff training, two-factor authentication, secure wireless networks, fortified endpoints, data backups, and selecting reputable service providers.

feed.title: Nasdaq 100 Index: Tech Stocks Lose $1.8 Trillion in a Month Thanks to Fed
feed.summary: Tech investors have experienced the worst start to the year in two decades, with the Nasdaq 100 Index losing over $1.8 trillion in value in April alone. This decline is attributed to a tumultuous earnings season, fears of an economic slowdown, and aggressive expectations regarding the Federal Reserve's rate-hike trajectory, with another hike anticipated next week. Investors are bracing for continued volatility in the market.

feed.title: Amazon’s biggest drop since 2006 caps dismal month for tech
feed.summary: Amazon.com Inc. shares experienced their largest one-day drop since 2006, sinking 14% and erasing $206.2 billion from its market value, following a disappointing outlook. This slump contributed to a dismal April for major tech companies like Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, and Tesla, which collectively lost a trillion dollars in market value due to tumultuous earnings, rising costs, and concerns over Federal Reserve policy. The Nasdaq 100 Index also saw its biggest one-month decline since October 2008.

feed.title: Companies Across North America Turning to SAP for Cloud Transformation
feed.summary: SAP announced robust cloud bookings growth in North America for Q1 2022, primarily driven by companies adopting the RISE with SAP solution for cloud transformations. Key customers like PetSmart, Rivian, The Chemours Company, and TELUS Communications are leveraging SAP's cloud solutions to future-proof their operations. Microsoft also announced its adoption of RISE with SAP and SAP S/4HANA for its own ERP transformation, further highlighting the widespread trust in SAP's offerings.

feed.title: Toronto, Montreal data centre markets grow, but face challenges
feed.summary: Toronto and Montreal are experiencing significant growth in their data center markets but face challenges, primarily the scarcity of available land for expansion. While Toronto is the largest Canadian market with high absorption rates, its extremely low industrial vacancy and escalating land prices make new entry difficult. Montreal benefits from cheaper, sustainable power but grapples with power constraints from Hydro-Québec and some companies' reluctance due to language or legal reasons.

feed.title: Nvidia’s CFO on how they retain tech talent —even as the Great Resignation continues
feed.summary: Colette Kress, Nvidia's CFO, discusses the company's strategies for retaining top tech talent amidst the Great Resignation. She emphasizes that beyond competitive salaries, a strong culture focused on continuous learning, challenging work, and an egalitarian leadership approach are key factors. Nvidia provides unique upskilling opportunities, offers benefits like "Free Days" and an employee stock purchase program, and fosters an environment where all employees are valued and have opportunities to lead, regardless of title.

feed.title: Telkom dan Microsoft Perkuat Kemitraan Strategis untuk Akselerasi Digitalisasi Indonesia – Indonesia News Center
feed.summary: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk and Microsoft have signed a strategic partnership agreement to accelerate Indonesia's national digitalization, strengthen intelligent infrastructure, and speed up TelkomGroup's digital transformation. This collaboration, which continues a previous MoU from August 2021, aims to enable innovative and impactful services in accelerating Indonesia's digital transformation by combining Telkom's extensive infrastructure with Microsoft's global technology capabilities. The partnership also includes internal digital transformation for Telkom and its subsidiaries, focusing on cloud adoption, competency enhancement, and collaboration in developing national intelligent infrastructure.

feed.title: Is the Proliferation of Cybersecurity Vendors Helping or Hurting Healthcare?
feed.summary: The healthcare sector faces a challenge with the increasing number of cybersecurity vendors. Michael Carr, CISO at Health First, suggests a shift from simply spending more to investing more wisely in cybersecurity solutions. Organizations should evaluate vendors based on administrative burden, ROI, scalability, staffing needs, and the vendor's internal security practices, prioritizing solutions that align with core business goals rather than just cybersecurity for its own sake.

feed.title: Top 10 Growth Stocks by Market Capitalization
feed.summary: This article defines growth stocks and explains how they differ from other investment types, highlighting their potential for capital appreciation and typical reinvestment strategies. It then presents a list of the top 10 large-cap growth stocks as of April 2022, detailing their market capitalization, forward P/E ratio, dividend status, and specific growth drivers for each company. The article also touches on general market performance of growth stocks and factors influencing their volatility.

feed.title: Telkom and Microsoft Strengthen Strategic Partnership to Accelerate Indonesia's Digitalization
feed.summary: Telkom and Microsoft have formed a strategic partnership to accelerate Indonesia's national digitalization, enhance intelligent infrastructure, and advance TelkomGroup's digital transformation. This collaboration, a continuation of an August 2021 MOU, aims to leverage Telkom's infrastructure and Microsoft's digital capabilities to offer innovative services and support Telkom's vision as a leading digital telecommunications company. They will jointly explore new market opportunities, develop intelligent infrastructure, and facilitate Telkom's internal digital transformation by increasing cloud-based service adoption and employee competence.

feed.title: Covington Nabs Former Linklaters Antitrust Chief
feed.summary: Christian Ahlborn, former global head of antitrust at Linklaters, is joining Covington & Burling's Brussels office as a partner. This move anticipates a surge in demand for antitrust legal advice as new EU rules, such as the Digital Markets Act, are set to curb the power of major technology companies. The increased complexity and data-intensive nature of competition investigations are driving the need for more specialized legal expertise in the sector.

feed.title: Microsoft announces general availability of Microsoft Defender for Business designed to boost small and medium business (SMB) security
feed.summary: Microsoft has announced the general availability of Microsoft Defender for Business, a new cybersecurity solution specifically designed for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). This offering aims to provide enterprise-grade endpoint security, including detection and response capabilities against ransomware and other sophisticated cyberthreats, to SMBs. The solution is available standalone or as part of Microsoft 365 Business Premium, addressing the growing concern among SMBs about cybersecurity risks.

feed.title: Here’s why TELUS International is a buy right now
feed.summary: Greg Newman of Scotia Wealth Management recommends TELUS International (TSX:TIXT) as a buying opportunity, despite its recent dip alongside the broader software sector. He highlights the company's strong growth rate, its trading below issuance price, and attractive valuation at 19x its 2023 multiple. Newman suggests investors consider building a position gradually, expecting rewards over the next two to three years.

feed.title: N-able Introduces Cove Data Protection
feed.summary: N-able has launched Cove Data Protection, a new cloud-first data protection-as-a-service (DPaaS) solution designed for business-class backup and disaster recovery. This appliance-free offering aims to reduce the cost and complexity associated with traditional backup methods by leveraging a cloud-native architecture. Cove Data Protection provides comprehensive data protection for servers, workstations, and Microsoft 365, all managed from a single console, and includes flexible restore options and fully managed cloud storage.

feed.title: 13 Companies Offering Quantum Cloud Computing Software Services
feed.summary: This article lists and describes 13 leading companies that offer quantum cloud computing software services in 2025. It explains what quantum cloud computing is, highlighting its role in making expensive quantum hardware accessible to a wider audience, from researchers to enthusiasts. The article covers major players like IBM, Google, and Microsoft, as well as specialized quantum startups, detailing their cloud platforms and offerings.

feed.title: Analyzing BlackByte Ransomware's Go-Based Variants
feed.summary: Zscaler's ThreatLabz analyzes two Go-based variants of the BlackByte ransomware, which emerged in July 2021 and was later redeveloped from C# to Go. The analysis highlights the ransomware's anti-analysis techniques, privilege escalation methods, lateral propagation capabilities, and updated encryption algorithms, including the shift from RSA/AES to Curve25519 ECC and ChaCha20. The article also details how BlackByte avoids CIS countries, terminates security processes, and employs double extortion tactics by leaking exfiltrated data.

feed.title: How a local biotech company found its hybrid working environment "groove"
feed.summary: BioCryst, a biotech company, has successfully implemented a hybrid work model by actively soliciting and incorporating employee feedback. They designed a new office space at Frontier RTP to encourage collaboration while offering independent workspaces, and are utilizing new technologies like Microsoft Teams and virtual reality headsets in their labs. The company emphasizes ongoing dialogue with employees to continuously adapt and improve their hybrid environment globally.

feed.title: Microsoft deepens investment in Canada with the opening of new headquarters and expansion of operations to empower economic growth – Microsoft News Center Canada
feed.summary: Microsoft has opened its new Canadian headquarters in Toronto, marking a significant investment in the country's innovation economy. A new EY report indicates Microsoft's ecosystem supports nearly 300,000 jobs and contributes $37 billion to Canada's GDP. The company is also expanding its regional presence, supporting innovation projects, and a skills initiative that has trained over one million Canadians.

feed.title: Embracing The Inevitable Move From Hardware To Services
feed.summary: Dell Technologies is shifting its focus from hardware sales to software and services, as evidenced by its Dell Technologies World event. The company is expanding its Apex as-a-service portfolio, enhancing its storage software, and building multi-cloud solutions like Project Alpine to offer cloud-like consumption models and address the evolving needs of IT. This strategy aims to provide streamlined experiences, consistent data mobility, and robust cybersecurity solutions for on-premises and public cloud environments.

feed.title: d-Matrix Closes $44 Million in Series A
feed.summary: d-Matrix, a Santa Clara-based leader in high-efficiency AI compute for data centers, has secured $44 million in Series A funding. The round was led by Playground Global, with participation from M12 (Microsoft Venture Fund) and SK Hynix, as well as existing investors Nautilus Venture Partners, Marvell Technology, and Entrada Ventures. This investment will support product roadmap expansion and team growth across the United States, Australia, and India, and coincides with the announcement of their new silicon chiplet NighthawkTM, based on DIMC technology.

feed.title: Web3: It’s time to level up
feed.summary: HSBC's Rajeev Tummala discusses Web3, defined as the read-write-own era of the internet, where users control their data and interact in virtual worlds like the metaverse. He highlights its potential applications beyond gaming in financial services, education, and entertainment, while also acknowledging challenges such as intellectual property, regulation, and data privacy. The article concludes that Web3 will likely combine both centralized and decentralized systems and that financial institutions have a crucial role to play in its evolution.

feed.title: AES to porvide renewable power to Microsoft data centres in California
feed.summary: AES has contracted to supply renewable energy to Microsoft data centers in California. This agreement supports Microsoft's goal of powering 100% of its data centers, buildings, and operations with renewable energy by 2025. The article highlights the growing trend of corporate Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) for green energy.

feed.title: Microsoft signs 110MW PPA with AES to power California data centers
feed.summary: Microsoft has signed a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with AES to provide 110MWAC solar and 55MW, 4-hour storage renewable energy for its data centers in California. This agreement builds on previous collaborations between Microsoft and AES in Virginia and Chile, helping Microsoft achieve its goal of 100 percent renewable energy by 2025. The energy will partially match Microsoft's load at its California-based data centers, sourced from projects within the CAISO region.

feed.title: The Game Awards, Summer Game Fest Events To Air Live In Imax Theaters Via New Partnership
feed.summary: The Game Awards and Summer Game Fest producer Geoff Keighley has partnered with Imax to broadcast both annual gaming events live in Imax theaters across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. This collaboration aims to diversify Imax's content and offer an immersive viewing experience for gaming fans, starting with Summer Game Fest Live! on June 9. The partnership will also include The Game Awards, providing audiences with live game reveals, celebrity appearances, and musical performances in a shared cinema setting.

feed.title: Brookfield's venture capital arm cuts biggest check yet for Elon Musk's Twitter buyout
feed.summary: Brookfield Asset Management's venture capital division, Brookfield Growth, has committed US$250 million to Elon Musk's US$7.1 billion equity raise for his acquisition of Twitter Inc. This investment marks the largest single check written by Brookfield Growth to date and stems from an existing relationship between the billionaire and the Canadian asset manager. The partnership also extends to other ventures, including a sustainable housing development in Austin, Texas, involving Musk's Boring Co. and Tesla Energy.

feed.title: 2022 Selloff Has Left the U.S. Stock Market Undervalued
feed.summary: The 2022 stock market selloff has pushed the broad U.S. equity market into undervalued territory, trading at a 12% discount to fair value according to Morningstar's equity research. While value stocks remain attractive, growth stocks, particularly small-caps, now offer significant discounts after substantial declines. The article highlights undervalued opportunities in the Communications, Consumer Cyclical, Financial Services, and Technology sectors, despite ongoing headwinds like slowing economic growth, Federal Reserve tightening, rising interest rates, and inflation.

feed.title: Stock Price Trading Dynamics and Splits
feed.summary: This article examines the impact of stock price on market quality features and the decision to split a stock, focusing on the recent trend of large corporations splitting their high-priced stocks. It analyzes various market features like consolidated quoted spreads, quoted size coverage, and quote volatility across different stock price and volume categories. The analysis suggests that targeting stock prices in the $50-$100 range for liquid securities offers the best market quality results, although the evidence for splitting less liquid stocks is less convincing.

feed.title: This World Password Day consider ditching passwords altogether
feed.summary: On World Password Day, Microsoft urges users to consider ditching passwords entirely due to their inherent vulnerabilities and the rising frequency of password attacks. The article details how to enable passwordless sign-in for Microsoft accounts using various methods like the Microsoft Authenticator app or security keys. It also highlights the importance of multifactor authentication and offers tips for creating stronger passwords for accounts that still require them.

feed.title: This Year's Game Awards and Summer Game Fest to Air Live in IMAX
feed.summary: The Game Awards and Summer Game Fest will be broadcast live in IMAX theaters across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, marking a new partnership between show producer Geoff Keighley and IMAX. This initiative aims to offer gamers a more immersive experience for two of the biggest annual gaming events. The partnership is part of IMAX's strategy to diversify its content portfolio with more live and interactive events, leveraging the immersive nature of both video games and IMAX cinema.

feed.title: 7 Charts for Making Sense of These Markets
feed.summary: This article analyzes current market volatility through seven charts, highlighting the Federal Reserve's aggressive interest rate hikes as a primary driver. It discusses the impact on both stock and bond markets, the underperformance of growth stocks versus value stocks, and offers insights on potential opportunities for investors amidst the market adjustments.

feed.title: Kraft Heinz wants to solve its supply chain problems — in the metaverse
feed.summary: Kraft Heinz is leveraging the metaverse and a partnership with Microsoft to enhance its supply chain efficiency. By creating "digital twins" of its facilities, the company aims to resolve logistical issues virtually, speed up operations, and ensure products like Lunchables and Velveeta reach shelves faster. This technological investment seeks to improve dependability and responsiveness to shifting consumer demands.

feed.title: Adobe Inc. stock underperforms Friday when compared to competitors
feed.summary: Shares of Adobe Inc. (ADBE) fell 2.37% on Friday, closing at $391.01, amidst a generally negative trading session for the broader stock market. The stock underperformed several competitors, including Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) and Salesforce Inc. (CRM), which also saw declines. Adobe's stock ended the day significantly below its 52-week high.

feed.title: Holy-Moly Mortgage Rates Hit 5.64%, 10-Year Treasury Yield 3.12%, Long-Term Treasury Bond Fund Gets Massacred
feed.summary: Mortgage rates have surged to 5.64%, the highest since 2009, as the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 3.12%. This has led to a significant increase in monthly mortgage payments, impacting housing demand. A long-term Treasury bond ETF has plunged, indicating a "bond massacre" for investors who previously viewed bonds as a conservative investment.

feed.title: Meta is opening its first store as VR headsets inch closer to mainstream reality
feed.summary: Meta Platforms is opening its first physical store to sell VR headsets like the Oculus Quest 2, despite its Reality Labs division facing significant losses. The company is betting heavily on the metaverse, viewing it as the solution to boost virtual reality adoption beyond the current low engagement among teens. Experts suggest that widespread VR adoption could be triggered by one or two "killer applications" and that Meta's strategy is to build the foundational platform for this new computing paradigm, even if profitability remains years away.

feed.title: Concentrix Announces Acquisition of ServiceSource, a Global B2B Digital Sales Company
feed.summary: Concentrix Corporation announced its definitive agreement to acquire ServiceSource International, Inc., a global leader in B2B digital sales, for approximately $131 million. This acquisition aims to expand Concentrix's B2B sales capabilities, enhance its client portfolio, and is expected to be accretive to growth and profitability through significant revenue and cost synergies. The transaction is projected to close in the second half of fiscal year 2022, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.

feed.title: 15 Top Cities for Machine Learning Engineer Salaries
feed.summary: This article identifies the top 15 U.S. cities offering the highest salaries for Machine Learning Engineers, based on data from Blind. It highlights that major tech hubs like Silicon Valley and Seattle lead due to high demand from companies like Meta and Apple. The piece also notes the increasing importance and compensation for AI and machine learning skills across industries.

feed.title: As pandemic videogame boom wanes, merger madness takes over
feed.summary: The pandemic-driven boom in video games is subsiding, leading to a surge in mergers and acquisitions aimed at supporting stock prices. Despite a decline in usage, analysts like Cowen's Doug Creutz remain bullish on the sector due to M&A activity, highlighted by major acquisitions like Take-Two's purchase of Zynga and Microsoft's offer for Activision Blizzard. Electronic Arts is noted as one of the few large companies not yet involved in this M&A wave.

feed.title: Blackstone Announces Matthew Bromberg, Former COO at Zynga, as Senior Advisor
feed.summary: Blackstone announced the appointment of Matthew Bromberg, former Chief Operating Officer at Zynga, as a Senior Advisor.
