feed.title: Next-Generation Adobe Analytics Delivers Customer Insights From Streaming Media and the Metaverse
feed.summary: Adobe has launched new services for Adobe Analytics, creating a unified workspace for brands to gather data and insights from various media, including the metaverse and streaming content. This update allows for seamless data migration from other analytics platforms, ensuring compliance with regulations like GDPR and CCPA. By supporting emerging channels, Adobe Analytics aims to provide comprehensive omnichannel analysis through Customer Journey Analytics, helping businesses understand evolving consumer behaviors and deliver personalized experiences.

feed.title: The CISOs Report: A spotlight on today’s cybersecurity challenges
feed.summary: A new report, in partnership with Zscaler and the Cloud Security Alliance, surveyed over 400 CISOs globally to identify their primary cybersecurity challenges. The findings indicate that 80% of C-level executives prioritize zero trust, with most organizations experiencing material damage from cyber attacks in the past year. The article highlights key threats like ransomware and supply-chain attacks, stresses the importance of securing third-party risks, and offers recommendations such as network-agnostic architecture and immediate zero trust implementation.

feed.title: How Jabil’s New HQ Facilitates Collaboration Between Worldwide Teams
feed.summary: Jabil, a global technology solutions company with 260,000 employees worldwide, opened a new 175,000-square-foot headquarters in St. Petersburg, Florida, designed to foster collaboration. The facility, equipped with state-of-the-art Crestron technology, allows seamless communication between local and international teams. Clearwater, Fla.-based APG Technology was the audiovisual integrator for the project, ensuring a uniform and user-friendly experience across various collaboration spaces.

feed.title: P&G taps Microsoft for cloud services to boost production efficiency
feed.summary: Procter & Gamble has partnered with Microsoft to utilize its Azure cloud computing services and predictive analytics to enhance manufacturing efficiency, reduce costs, and improve product delivery. This collaboration aims to leverage digital manufacturing visibility and advanced analytics to optimize production processes for various P&G products globally. The initiative builds on four years of prior cooperation, focusing on better data utilization, automation, digital twins, and sustainability.

feed.title: National Grid's CIDO reimagines operating models, IT strategy
feed.summary: Adriana Karaboutis, National Grid's group chief information and digital officer (CIDO), discusses her approach to digitizing the company. She outlines a strategy that balances legacy IT with emerging technologies like AI, machine learning, and cloud computing, emphasizing a product operating model and agile methodologies. Karaboutis also highlights the CIDO's role in measuring and supporting sustainability initiatives and navigating the challenges of existing legacy infrastructure.

feed.title: L3Harris in talks to buy Israeli spyware firm NSO - reports
feed.summary: U.S. defence contractor L3Harris is reportedly in talks to acquire Israeli spyware firm NSO Group, a deal that would require approvals from U.S. and Israeli authorities and L3Harris's board. The potential acquisition raises concerns in the White House due to NSO's controversial Pegasus software, which has been used by governments to spy on individuals, leading to the company being blacklisted by the U.S. Commerce Department. If approved, the deal could potentially remove NSO from the banned list and allow its assets to be exclusively used with the United States and its allies.

feed.title: Procter & Gamble Partners With Microsoft To Transform And Accelerate Digital Manufacturing
feed.summary: Procter & Gamble (P&G) has partnered with Microsoft to advance digital manufacturing through cloud, AI, and digital transformation technologies. This multiyear collaboration aims to make manufacturing smarter by utilizing Microsoft Cloud, Azure data, and AI solutions to optimize P&G's manufacturing and packaging processes, initially focusing on diaper and paper towel production. The initiative seeks to improve predictive quality, reduce downtime, enhance supply chain efficiency, and explore the concept of an "industrial metaverse" for simulating manufacturing environments.

feed.title: Leidos Announces 2022 Supplier Innovation & Technology Award Winners
feed.summary: Leidos announced the recipients of its 2022 Supplier Innovation & Technology awards, recognizing partners for excellence in technology, collaboration, partnership, and innovation. The awards, presented at a symposium, included new categories like Secure Supply Chain Supplier of the Year. Cisco, ServiceNow, Carahsoft, Thundercat Technologies LLC, CyberCore Technologies, and HashiCorp were among the winners in various categories.

feed.title: Microsoft Targets Salesforce Clients With New Tools to Aid Sales Reps
feed.summary: Microsoft has introduced Viva Sales, a new program designed to integrate its Office and Teams applications with customer-relationship management (CRM) software, including its own and rival platforms like Salesforce. This initiative aims to attract Salesforce clients by allowing data synchronization between CRM systems and Microsoft's productivity suite. Viva Sales also incorporates AI tools to analyze sales calls, track customer sentiment, and provide actionable feedback to sales representatives.

feed.title: Ahead of the Game: D-Wave Delivers Prototype of Next-Generation Advantage2 Annealing Quantum Computer
feed.summary: D-Wave has announced the release of an experimental prototype for its next-generation Advantage2 annealing quantum computer, available through its Leap quantum cloud service. This prototype features over 500 qubits with a new Zephyr topology and 20-way inter-qubit connectivity, demonstrating early performance gains such as reduced error rates and improved solution quality. The full Advantage2 system, expected in 2023-2024, will boast 7,000 qubits and an innovative low-noise fabrication process, building on D-Wave's 15 years of experience in quantum annealing technology.

feed.title: Salesforce Sales Cloud Unlimited Edition adds AI, automation
feed.summary: Salesforce has integrated eight AI and automation tools into its Sales Cloud Unlimited Edition, maintaining the current pricing of $300 per user per month. This move aims to streamline operations and enhance sales productivity by automating manual tasks. Additionally, Salesforce plans to incorporate sales-oriented Slack features through its acquisition of Troops.ai, and Box Inc. has deepened its integration with Salesforce to include e-signature functionality and support for Salesforce Flow.

feed.title: ServiceNow Inc. stock underperforms Thursday when compared to competitors
feed.summary: ServiceNow Inc. (NOW) stock fell 8.13% on Thursday, closing at $428.08, significantly underperforming the broader market which also saw declines. This drop ended a two-day winning streak for the company. ServiceNow's stock also underperformed compared to competitors like Microsoft, Qualcomm, and IBM, and closed $279.52 below its 52-week high.

feed.title: Broadcom's acquire-and-axe history concerns VMware users
feed.summary: VMware users and employees are expressing concern over Broadcom's acquisition of the company, fearing a repeat of Broadcom's historical strategy of acquiring and then divesting parts of companies. Broadcom's CEO, Hock Tan, intends to transition VMware to a subscription-based model and integrate Broadcom's infrastructure and security software. The acquisition timing also coincides with a trend where corporate IT shops are moving towards SaaS-based solutions, diminishing VMware's traditional market.

feed.title: Is Juneteenth being observed by companies in the Dow industrials? Here's how some are handling it.
feed.summary: This article explores how companies in the Dow industrials are observing Juneteenth, a federal holiday. While many Dow components are closed, some are open, and others offer employees the choice to take it as a paid holiday. The article also notes the relatively quick adoption of Juneteenth as a day off for exchanges compared to Martin Luther King, Jr. Day.

feed.title: Native Advertising Examples: 17 of the Best and Most Inspiring Native Ads
feed.summary: This article showcases 17 successful native advertising campaigns by various global brands, highlighting how native ads integrate seamlessly into content to drive engagement, awareness, and sales. It emphasizes native advertising's effectiveness as a non-interruptive and contextually relevant alternative to traditional ads, detailing increased CTRs, lead generation, and ROAS achieved by companies like Adidas, Vodafone, and Square Yards through platforms like Taboola. The article concludes by reinforcing why native advertising is a powerful digital marketing technique, citing its non-disruptive nature and contextual relevance.

feed.title: Why ESG is Becoming a Bigger Deal for Investors
feed.summary: ESG (environmental, social, and governance) investing is rapidly gaining traction, with a record $649 billion poured into ESG-focused funds in 2021. Major players like BlackRock are emphasizing ESG, believing that companies deliberating on their societal role perform better, leading to long-term value for shareholders. While greenwashing concerns exist, new global standards and regulatory clarifications are emerging as ESG becomes a mainstream method for evaluating businesses and attracting investment.

feed.title: The Hong Kong Management Association and Microsoft Hong Kong Showcase Technology Excellence, Innovation and Resilience – Microsoft News Center Hong Kong
feed.summary: The Hong Kong Management Association (HKMA) and Microsoft Hong Kong (MSHK) recognized 14 Hong Kong companies for their innovative use of technology in the inaugural HKMA x MSHK Excellence in Digital Transformation. These companies demonstrated successful integration of various technologies, including cloud, big data, and AI, across five categories: customer engagement, employee empowerment, product transformation, operations optimization, and all-rounded innovation. The initiative highlights Hong Kong businesses' agility in leveraging technology to navigate challenges, seize opportunities, and enhance operational models.

feed.title: A closer look at P&G’s ‘water positive’ pledge
feed.summary: Procter & Gamble has announced a "water positive" goal by 2030, aiming to restore more water than its operations and products consume. The initiative includes two new restoration pledges focusing on water consumed during manufacturing and by household product use in 18 water-stressed regions, primarily Los Angeles and Mexico City. P&G is investing in various restoration projects and integrating sustainability metrics into executive compensation, while experts commend the company's rigorous approach to consumer-use impact but call for more engagement with public policy for broader impact.

feed.title: Corsair Dark Core RGB Pro SE wireless gaming mouse review
feed.summary: The Corsair Dark Core RGB Pro SE is a heavy, feature-rich wireless gaming mouse offering excellent connectivity and ergonomics. While praised for its build quality, customizable RGB, and precise sensor, its significant weight (142g) and mediocre battery life (20 hours with RGB on) are notable drawbacks, especially for competitive FPS players. The review concludes that it's a great option for those who prefer comfortable, heavier mice for productivity and slower-paced games, rather than twitch shooters.

feed.title: Microsoft Office 365 has ability to ‘spy’ on workers
feed.summary: Research has revealed that Microsoft Office 365 contains tools that allow employers to monitor staff emails and computer usage, raising privacy concerns. Despite Microsoft's 2020 changes to protect employee privacy by aggregating data, UCL research found that "content search" and "audit" tools still enable detailed individual surveillance. This has led to calls for Microsoft to increase transparency and notify employees when such monitoring tools are enabled.

feed.title: First Watch Adds Bumble Executive Stephanie Lilak to Board of Directors
feed.summary: First Watch Restaurant Group has appointed Stephanie Lilak, Chief People Officer of Bumble Inc., to its Board of Directors, effective June 17, 2022. Lilak will join the Audit Committee and Compensation Committee, bringing extensive human resources experience from her roles at Bumble Inc., Dunkin’ Brands, and General Mills. Her appointment is expected to support First Watch’s growth and its people-centric "You First" culture.

feed.title: Oracle introduces lower-cost version of its full on-premises cloud stack
feed.summary: Oracle has introduced a more affordable version of its on-premises cloud stack, Dedicated Region Cloud@Customer, alongside a new rack-level offering called Oracle Compute Cloud@Customer. The new Dedicated Region Cloud@Customer reduces the required space and annual cost significantly, making Oracle's full public cloud services, including Fusion applications, accessible to a broader range of global companies for workloads that cannot fully migrate to the public cloud. Oracle Compute Cloud@Customer provides managed on-site computing and storage resources for smaller workloads, similar to offerings from AWS, Microsoft, and Google.

feed.title: YPF explora la Computación Cuántica para el desarrollo de la transición energética junto a Microsoft
feed.summary: YPF is partnering with Microsoft to explore the use of quantum computing for developing energy transition sources and retraining its technical teams. The project aims to accelerate the adoption of renewable energy and reinforce YPF's commitment to sustainability. It began with a training program for YPF's Digital Technologies teams, led by Microsoft experts, to identify potential pilot applications in 2022.

feed.title: Microsoft stops selling emotion-reading tech, limits face recognition
feed.summary: Microsoft Corp announced it will stop selling emotion-reading technology based on facial images and will also limit unfettered access to its facial recognition technology. This move aligns with efforts by leading cloud providers to self-regulate sensitive technologies as lawmakers consider new legal limits. Existing customers of emotion-reading tools will have one year before losing access, and facial recognition services will now require approval for use.

feed.title: Tech companies still scooping up office space and Vancouver’s feeling the squeeze
feed.summary: Despite the rise of remote work, Vancouver's downtown office vacancy rate remains low at 7.4%, driven by demand from large tech companies. These companies are drawn to Vancouver due to lower operating costs compared to other major tech hubs. However, this demand is making office space expensive, with Vancouver having the highest per-square-foot cost in Canada.

feed.title: MinIO extends Snowflake analysis to any data location
feed.summary: MinIO has partnered with Snowflake to enable Snowflake analytics on data stored in any location, not just within Snowflake's own environment. This partnership allows customers to leverage external table support in MinIO for cost-effective analysis of large datasets without moving them to the cloud. This provides flexibility similar to recent Snowflake partnerships with Dell and Pure Storage, offering various options for on-premises or cloud-based data analysis.

feed.title: Avnet, and Amazon Web Services enters into a global strategic partnership
feed.summary: Avnet and Amazon Web Services (AWS) have formed a global strategic partnership aimed at helping Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) of IoT solutions accelerate their time to market. This collaboration will enable Avnet’s IoTConnect Platform to leverage AWS's extensive portfolio of services, creating a scalable and secure platform for application-specific usage. The partnership provides OEMs with pre-integrated and abstracted capabilities, such as device provisioning, multi-layer security, and business intelligence, allowing them to focus on differentiating their connected products.

feed.title: Cloudflare recognized by Microsoft as a Security Software Innovator
feed.summary: Cloudflare announced it has won the Security Software Innovator award at the 2022 Microsoft Security Excellence Awards. This recognition highlights Cloudflare's innovative approach to Zero Trust and security solutions through deep integrations with Microsoft, helping joint customers secure their web applications and employees. The article emphasizes the importance of Zero Trust in the modern threat landscape, detailing Cloudflare One's comprehensive capabilities.

feed.title: Microsoft Viva Sales takes on Salesforce-Slack tandem
feed.summary: Microsoft is set to launch Viva Sales, an AI-powered automation tool designed to integrate sales data from Microsoft 365 and Teams directly into CRM systems, challenging Salesforce's offerings. Viva Sales aims to streamline sales processes by reducing manual data entry and app-switching, particularly for remote workers. This move intensifies the rivalry between Microsoft and Salesforce, with both companies focusing on enhancing employee experience through AI and automation in sales.

feed.title: ECOLAB3D™: Putting Real Time Data to Work for Industrial Water Management
feed.summary: ECOLAB3D is an IIOT platform built on Microsoft Azure that uses real-time data, AI, and machine learning to optimize industrial water management. It helps companies achieve performance, compliance, and savings goals by providing actionable insights from diverse system data. The platform has achieved SOC 2 Type I certification, demonstrating its commitment to data security and integrity for customers.

feed.title: BWT Alpine F1 Team turns big data into faster track times with data science platform built on Azure and Azure NetApp Files
feed.summary: BWT Alpine F1 Team implemented a new cloud-hosted data science platform using Microsoft Azure and Azure NetApp Files to enhance race performance. The platform integrates racing, testing, and manufacturing data, emphasizing "fast data" to enable quick decision-making for engineers. This move has allowed Alpine to rapidly scale resources, manage costs effectively, and improve productivity.

feed.title: NYLI Winslow Focused Large Cap Growth ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NYSEARCA:IWFG)
feed.summary: The NYLI Winslow Focused Large Cap Growth ETF (IWFG) is an actively managed, non-transparent ETF focused on achieving long-term capital appreciation by investing in US large-cap growth companies. Launched on June 23, 2022, and managed by IndexIQ, the ETF had assets under management of $60.06 million as of July 2, 2026, with a net expense ratio of 0.65%. Its top holdings include major tech companies like NVIDIA, Microsoft, Apple, and Alphabet.

feed.title: Roe v. Wade overturned: Here are companies paying for abortion travel costs for employees
feed.summary: Following the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, numerous major U.S. companies announced expanded support and financial assistance for employees seeking abortions in states with new restrictions. This support often includes covering travel expenses for medical care unavailable in their home states. Corporations are responding to pressure from investors, customers, and employees, and are concerned about the impact on talent attraction and retention.

feed.title: Disney, other U.S. companies offer abortion travel benefit after Roe decision
feed.summary: Following the U.S. Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, numerous U.S. companies, including Walt Disney Co. and Meta Platforms Inc., announced they would cover travel expenses for employees seeking abortion services. This move comes as many states are expected to restrict or ban abortions, making it necessary for employees to travel to states where the procedure remains legal. Companies like Dick's Sporting Goods, Lyft, Yelp, Microsoft, Tesla, Apple, Alaska Air Group, Johnson & Johnson, OkCupid, Bumble, Netflix, and JPMorgan Chase & Co. are also offering similar benefits or legal protections.

feed.title: Five9 Integration with Microsoft Teams Review
feed.summary: This article reviews the integration of Five9 with Microsoft Teams, highlighting how it enhances customer service by connecting agents with subject matter experts in real-time. The integration offers features like agent-expert consultation and telephony connect, aiming to bridge communication gaps and improve customer experience. It details benefits such as full organizational collaboration, boosted CX, simplified directories, toll-free call transfers, and an improved employee experience.

feed.title: IICS 2022: How to Secure Essential Infrastructure Systems Against Cyber Threats
feed.summary: The article discusses the critical need to secure essential infrastructure systems against cyber threats, emphasizing that these attacks are borderless and require global collaboration between public and private sectors. Cybersecurity experts gathered at IICS 2022 highlighted the urgency of addressing both information technology (IT) and operational technology (OT) vulnerabilities, advocating for greater consistency in requirements and collaboration among governments and vendors. They stressed that IT and OT must integrate their efforts to achieve true security from cyberattacks.

feed.title: Ransomware rising: A look at ThreatLabz’ latest findings
feed.summary: A report from Zscaler's ThreatLabz indicates a significant increase in ransomware attacks, with an 80% rise between February 2021 and March 2022, and a 120% jump in double extortion incidents. Manufacturing remains the most targeted industry, while the use of ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) and supply chain attacks are also increasing. The article emphasizes that zero trust principles and employee education are crucial defenses against these evolving threats.

feed.title: Abortion assistance: Kroger to offer up to $4,000 of out-of-state travel costs for employees seeking abortion
feed.summary: Kroger announced it will offer up to $4,000 to cover out-of-state travel costs for employees seeking abortion and fertility treatments, following the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. The company, headquartered in Cincinnati, operates stores in states like Ohio and Kentucky where abortion is now banned or mostly banned. This move aligns Kroger with nearly two dozen other major U.S. companies providing similar assistance.

feed.title: HoloLens 2 helps Novo Nordisk employees see work in new ways
feed.summary: Novo Nordisk is implementing Microsoft HoloLens 2 and related Dynamics 365 technologies to transform its manufacturing operations and employee training. This includes using augmented instructions for complex procedures and facilitating virtual site visits, significantly improving efficiency, onboarding, and reducing travel needs across its global facilities. The technology has been well-received by employees, leading to improved performance consistency and a more flexible workplace.

feed.title: KPMG leads Digital Future of Work hackathon
feed.summary: KPMG, in collaboration with Microsoft, BP plc, and the University of Cambridge Think Lab, hosted a two-day "Digital Future of Work" hackathon in London. The event focused on developing digital solutions for modern business challenges, including talent retention and hybrid work, aligning with the UN's Sustainable Development Goal of "Decent work and economic growth." The winning solution, "The Good Job Tool," helps design roles that meet candidate expectations and market demands, receiving investment and support from KPMG.

feed.title: Why treasury automation is a must
authors: flow’s Desiree Buchholz and Helen Sanders
feed.summary: The COVID-19 pandemic significantly accelerated the urgency of treasury automation for corporate treasurers. Companies had to quickly adopt digital processes to ensure resilience and maintain cash visibility amidst lockdowns and supply chain disruptions. The article highlights that automation is an ongoing task, with banks and fintechs collaborating to provide accessible and cost-effective solutions for tasks like cash flow forecasting, receivables reconciliation, and liquidity management, which were previously out of reach for many businesses.

feed.title: Best Digital Planner for OneNote
feed.summary: The article identifies the Key2Success OneNote Digital Planner as the top choice for 2024, highlighting its professional design and goal-oriented system. It outlines various editions available (Personal, Professional, Business, Executive) and new features like customizable pages and team tools in the Business Executive version. The planner is praised for syncing across multiple devices and its continuous improvement based on user feedback.

feed.title: HDFC Bank-backed Lentra AI to acquire TheDataTeam
feed.summary: Digital lending platform Lentra AI, backed by HDFC Bank, has acquired artificial intelligence solutions company TheDataTeam for an undisclosed amount. The acquisition aims to enhance Lentra's offerings by integrating TheDataTeam's Cadenz behavior intelligence platform to help banks and financial institutions make better data-driven decisions on customer loan repayment histories. Rangarajan Vasudevan, founder of TheDataTeam, will join Lentra as co-founder and chief data officer, strengthening Lentra's position in the credit market.

feed.title: FabricScape: Escaping Service Fabric and Taking Over the Cluster
feed.summary: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 researchers identified FabricScape (CVE-2022-30137), an important vulnerability in Microsoft's Service Fabric that allows Linux containers to escalate privileges and gain root access, potentially compromising an entire cluster. This vulnerability affects Azure Service Fabric and other Microsoft products using it, though certain managed multi-tenant services have runtime access disabled, preventing exploitation. Microsoft has patched the issue, and users not on automatic updates are advised to upgrade their Linux clusters.

feed.title: Accenture and Avanade Named Microsoft 2022 Global SI Partner of the Year for 17th Time
feed.summary: Accenture and Avanade have been named the Microsoft 2022 Global SI Partner of the Year for the 17th time, a record achievement. They also received ten additional awards, including several country-level Partner of the Year awards, recognizing their excellence in innovation and implementation of customer solutions based on Microsoft technology. This acknowledges their combined service capabilities, global scale, and solution development in solving complex client challenges and addressing sustainability.

feed.title: I tried Elon Musk's Starlink internet on a Royal Caribbean cruise ship
feed.summary: The author tested Elon Musk's Starlink internet on Royal Caribbean's Freedom of the Seas. Initial speeds were significantly faster than Royal Caribbean's typical Voom service, allowing for streaming and Zoom calls. While speeds varied slightly in different ship locations, Starlink generally far exceeded expectations for internet at sea.

feed.title: News | KKR in Talks To Buy Microsoft-Occupied Office Buildings in Atlanta
feed.summary: Private equity firm KKR is in discussions to acquire two office buildings in Atlanta, totaling 523,000 square feet, which are fully occupied by Microsoft. The buildings, located at Atlantic Yards, were developed by Invesco and Hines. This potential acquisition highlights significant investment activity in prime office real estate.

feed.title: |‘Sokaiya’ gone, but scandals continue at listed companies
feed.summary: |Corporate racketeering, once a significant problem in Japan with "sokaiya" disrupting shareholder meetings, has drastically declined due to revised laws and police crackdowns. However, despite the decline in racketeering, major Japanese companies like Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group and Mitsubishi Electric Corp. faced new types of scandals prompting apologies at their annual shareholder meetings. These incidents highlight ongoing corporate governance issues, including market manipulation and product quality control misconduct, leading to pledges for improved internal measures and transparency.

feed.title: DISA looks to install 10GB ethernet line from Equinix data center to DHS facility
feed.summary: The Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) is seeking bids to install and maintain a 10GB ethernet line connecting an Equinix data center in Dallas, Texas, to a Department of Homeland Security (DHS) facility in Pensacola, Florida. This initiative supports DHS's ongoing cloud migration efforts, which involve shifting workloads from their current data centers to cloud providers like AWS. The move comes amid continued spending on existing facilities and some controversy surrounding cloud contracts with human rights groups and Google employees protesting deals with ICE.

feed.title: Announcing the 2022 Microsoft US Award Winners
feed.summary: Microsoft has announced the winners of its 2022 US Partner Awards, which complement the global Microsoft Partner of the Year program by highlighting US-specific partner impact. The awards recognize partners across various categories including Azure AI, Business Applications, Business Excellence, Modern Work & Security, Social Impact, and Industry-specific solutions. The announcement encourages partners to register for the upcoming Microsoft Inspire virtual event on July 19-20, 2022.

feed.title: Sharebite Raises Additional $39M in Series B
feed.summary: Sharebite, a corporate food ordering platform, has raised an additional $39 million in a Series B funding round, led by Prosus, one of the world's largest technology investors. The company, which saw a 30x increase in daily order volume in 2021, plans to use the investment to expand its footprint and launch new products for modern workplaces. This funding follows a partnership with Vornado Realty Trust, making Sharebite the exclusive office meal solution in 20.6 million square feet of Manhattan office space.

feed.title: Watch: When Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer laughed at iPhone
feed.summary: This article revisits a famous incident where then-Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer publicly dismissed the original Apple iPhone upon its launch. He criticized its high price and lack of a physical keyboard, believing it wouldn't appeal to business users. Years later, Ballmer admitted his mistake, acknowledging Apple's innovative business model and regretting Microsoft's slow entry into the hardware business for mobile devices.

feed.title: HPE Is The First Big OEM To Adopt Ampere Computing Arm Chips
feed.summary: HPE has announced its adoption of Ampere Computing's "Mystique" Altra Max Arm server chip in its standard ProLiant rack-mounted server, marking Ampere's first major OEM server maker partnership. This move, showcased with the ProLiant RL300 server, signifies HPE's renewed commitment to Arm-based processors after previous cautious ventures. The decision is driven by the Altra chips' deterministic performance and competitive price/performance, particularly for cloud-native workloads, positioning HPE to compete aggressively against Intel Xeon and AMD Epyc processors.

feed.title: Merck and NJIT's New Jersey Innovation Institute Partner on Health Care Startup Development
feed.summary: Merck and the New Jersey Innovation Institute (NJII) have launched the Merck Digital Sciences Studio (MDSS) to foster innovative technologies for drug discovery and development. The MDSS will support early-stage biomedical startups, particularly those focusing on AI and machine learning, with direct investment, cloud computing access, and opportunities to pilot technologies with Merck scientists. This collaboration aims to accelerate digital technologies in pharmaceutical research and development through locations in Newark, N.J., and Cambridge, Mass.

feed.title: Discord IPO: Everything to know about Discord
feed.summary: This article provides an in-depth look at Discord ahead of its anticipated IPO, covering its valuation, business model, competitors, and growth strategy. It details how the company generates revenue primarily through its Nitro subscription service and outlines its efforts to expand beyond its core gaming audience. The piece also discusses Discord's profitability status, ownership, and key personnel.

feed.title: BP, Shell To Pay Employee Travel Costs After Abortion Ruling
feed.summary: Following the U.S. Supreme Court's reversal of Roe v. Wade, BP Plc and Shell Plc announced they would cover travel expenses for U.S. employees needing to access health services not available near their homes. This makes them the first major oil companies to implement such policies. Both companies maintain significant operations in Texas, a state expected to ban or severely restrict abortions, joining other corporate giants in expanding employee health benefits.

feed.title: Corsair TC200 gaming chair review: "A great chair for both work and play"
feed.summary: The Corsair TC200 gaming chair offers significant improvements over its predecessor, the T3 Rush, particularly for larger users with its wider seat and back, and internal lumbar support. Reviewer Frederick Hillinger praises its all-day comfort for both work and gaming, despite the lumbar support not being adjustable. The chair is highly recommended for its strong value, high-quality materials, and thoughtful design that incorporates user feedback.

feed.title: DevOps 2030: People, Practices, And Platforms
feed.summary: DevOps has proven its value in software-intensive organizations by reducing time-to-market, increasing agility, and enhancing resilience. Looking ahead to 2030, the evolution of DevOps will focus on three key areas: people, practices, and platforms. Success will involve fine-tuning team integration, automating processes to free up human attention, and consolidating and expanding DevOps platforms to support new technologies like low/no-code apps and MLOps.

feed.title: Cloudera embraces Apache Iceberg as cloud data lake evolves
feed.summary: Cloudera has announced support for Apache Iceberg, an open-source cloud data lake table format, within its Cloudera Data Platform. This move signifies Cloudera's continued evolution from its Hadoop roots towards modern cloud data lake technology. The company believes Iceberg enhances its ability to work with various cloud providers and analytical engines, addressing the growing need for flexible and structured data lake solutions in enterprise environments.
